# Project: Nepali Pasal (shared_shop)
Spring Boot 3.1.5, Java 17, Thymeleaf, Spring Data JPA, Oracle DB, Maven.
Backend: src/main/java/jp/co/sss/shop/** | Frontend: src/main/resources/templates, static/css/stylesheet.css, static/js/common.js

## Working rules (IMPORTANT - save tokens)
- Do ONLY what I ask. Nothing extra.
- Do NOT refactor, rename, reformat, or "improve" code I did not mention.
- Do NOT create new files (tests, README, docs, markdown summaries) unless I ask.
- Do NOT scan the whole project. Read only the files I mention or that are directly needed.
- Do NOT run builds, tests, or terminal commands unless I ask.
- Do NOT add new dependencies or change pom.xml unless I ask.
- Make the smallest possible change. Edit existing files; do not rewrite whole files.
- If the request is unclear, ask ONE short question instead of guessing.

## Response style
- Short answers. No long explanations, no summary of what you did unless asked.
- Show only the changed code (with file path), not the full file.
- Reply in simple English (or Nepali/Romanized Nepali if I write in it).

## Code conventions
- Keep existing structure: Controller -> Service -> Repository -> Entity.
- Use existing patterns (Form + Validator, @LoginCheck, Thymeleaf layouts).
- Do not touch desktop CSS when I ask for mobile changes (use @media blocks).
- Do not hardcode secrets/passwords in code or properties.
